own_project_process.limitation: RSS sampled every3s, not continuous full-run maximum. Earlier process_cpu_percent zeros are invalid and excluded; earlier RSS remains valid. CPU metric is relative to one logical core; whole-system percentages have different normalization.

scope: Whole-system telemetry includes user applications and preprocessing. GPU totals are not model-specific VRAM. Benchmark Torch-allocator peaks are reported separately. Resource window ends after benchmark completion, excludes later manuscript production.
